|game_text=Adds 1 to power of anything he pilots. While aboard your starship, adds 1 to its total weapon destiny. Whenever you hit a starship here, opponent loses 1 Force. During battle, may lose 1 Force to cancel [Coruscant] [[Watch Your Back! (V){{!}}Watch Your Back!]].
|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 of [[Captain Verrack (V)]]; it is the current text. No published card image shows this text, so the image here is a CardMaker recreation of it ([[:File:VB8-p3-71-Captain_Verrack-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]], made 9 November 2026). The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB8-p3-71-Captain_Verrack.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB8-L-captainverrack-pre.gif]]) show the original text (see [[Captain Verrack (V)]]).
* '''Original''' ([[Captain Verrack (V)]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 8.2 release sheet (official text as of 14 September 2012)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock8_2">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_2.pdf Virtual Block 8.2 release sheet] ("Official text as of September 14, 2012"; the surviving copy was re-made 18 October 2012). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022233130/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_2.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>: “[Pilot] 1. While aboard your starship, its total weapon destiny is +1. Whenever you hit a starship here, opponent loses 1 Force. During battle, may lose 1 Force to cancel [Coruscant] Watch Your Back!.” The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB8-p3-71-Captain_Verrack.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB8-L-captainverrack-pre.gif]]) print it. The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013, Light Side p. 5) prints this text again; that copy is a stale reprint, not a new version, because the PC website card list already showed the later text (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026).<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): The PC website card list (shown there by 12 December 2012 and in the capture of 11 January 2013) changed “its total weapon destiny is +1” to “adds 1 to its total weapon destiny”<ref name="cl-1282_15-2012-12-12">Players Committee website card list (VBlock8Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20121212003733/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 2012-12-12] (Internet Archive); the same text in the capture of 11 January 2013 (the card is not in the capture of 21 July 2012, before Virtual Block 8.2)</ref>: “Adds 1 to power of anything he pilots. While aboard your starship, adds 1 to its total weapon destiny. Whenever you hit a starship here, opponent loses 1 Force. During battle, may lose 1 Force to cancel [Coruscant] Watch Your Back!.” (The card list writes the pilot icon out as “Adds 1 to power of anything he pilots.”) No published card image shows this text; the image of that page is a CardMaker recreation ([[:File:VB8-p3-71-Captain_Verrack-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]]).
